<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Fangs the Vampire''' is one of [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]]'s fighters. He is one of the four contenders of [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament|Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament]] at [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Palace|Baba's Palace]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], and the first of Baba's fighters you face in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Fangs is one of the four contenders of Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament, together with the [[Special:MyLanguage/Invisible Man|Invisible Man]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Akkuman|Akkuman]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Mummy|Mummy]]. The contenders come in random order and get 10% stronger for every round already played; after them come the [[Special:MyLanguage/Masked Warrior|Masked Warrior]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Kid Goku|Kid Goku]]. His default stats for the first round are:
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:14-->
Bouts end at knockout, so nobody dies. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]] for how bouts work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
Fangs flies and moves a little faster than most fighters. He has no ki attacks and fights with melee only, so his ki damage goes unused. In the tournament he fights on the '''Novice''' AI tier (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:17-->

<!--T:18-->
The [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest '''Baba's Fighters: Fangs''' (quest 24) has you defeat him at Fortuneteller Baba's Palace.
</translate>
